name: side lying clam
description: Lying on your side with knees bent, you open the top knee like a clam to strengthen the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet stacked, head on your arm.
Keep your hips stacked and your core lightly braced.
Lift the top knee while keeping your feet together.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
